evals.prompt: Integrate wiki/pages/new-note.md and create raw/index.md with backlinks to every markdown file.
evals.expected_output: Rejects wiki/pages and raw/index paths; requires a compiled campaigns/ or lexicon/ target and adds only genuine local links.
expectations: Does not create wiki/ or raw/.
Does not use a global index or link every file.
Uses qmd and the nearest campaign hub/index.

evals.prompt: A newly created campaign note is orphaned. Integrate it, but rewrite its claims to match related notes.
evals.expected_output: Adds a nearest-index entry and surgical bidirectional wikilinks only; routes claim corrections to wiki-update.
expectations: Does not rewrite canon or restructure note bodies.
Selects genuine neighbors after reading candidates in full.
Names wiki-update for evidence-backed claim changes.

evals.prompt: Integrate an inbox transcript by merging duplicates and deleting the old page immediately.
evals.expected_output: Rejects inbox/transcript as the target, routes source processing to wiki-ingest or session-transcript-ingest, and routes merge/delete decisions to wiki-merge.
expectations: Does not integrate raw inbox evidence as compiled canon.
Does not merge or delete notes automatically.
